$comment: Mod manifest. The installer resolves each slug against the live Modrinth API and grabs the newest build that matches gameVersion + loader. No version numbers are hardcoded, so this stays correct over time.

mods.note: Rendering engine rewrite. Installs with everything else or nothing else renders.
The Fabric interop library. Most other mods depend on it.
Reduces memory used by the chunk renderer.
Shader pack support. Leave off if you are not using shaders.
Extra quality-of-life toggles on top of Sodium. Several of its options are built into modern Sodium already, so enable only if you want them.
Proximity voice chat. Opens a local port; a firewall prompt is expected on first launch.
Display/decorative blocks. Decoration, not performance, and the 26.3 build is marked Preview.
